title: The Ant Road around the Crumb
youtube_title: The Ant Road around the Crumb | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Not every treasure needs to be pocketed.
summary: At a bedroom window on a frosty morning, Gita finds an ant road going the long way around a crumb. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Gita shows Tamsin how to look without disturbing it. Auntie June looks too, and they leave it where it is.
